tests.steps: 1. Log in as a full-time staff member on 1 January 2. Open 'My leave'
1. Log in as a full-time staff member who has booked 20 days this year 2. Request 1 more day of annual leave
tests.expected: The request is blocked with the message that the allowance is used up

tests.steps: 1. Log in as a staff member with 19 days booked 2. Request 1 day 3. Then request 1 more day
tests.expected: The first request is allowed (total 20); the second is blocked (total 21)

tests.steps: 1. Give a staff member 3 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
1. Give a staff member 7 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
tests.expected: 5 days are carried over and 2 days are shown as lost

tests.steps: 1. Test with 5 unused days 2. Test again with 6 unused days
tests.expected: 5 days: all 5 carried over (allowed). 6 days: only 5 carried over, 1 lost (blocked)

tests.steps: 1. Log in as a staff member with 12 days left
tests.expected: The home screen shows '12 days left'

tests.steps: 1. Log in as a staff member with 0 days left
tests.expected: The home screen shows '0 days left' (not blank and not an error)

tests.steps: 1. Have a 3-day request approved 2. Return to the home screen
tests.expected: The balance has gone down by 3 days

tests.steps: 1. Have a request declined 2. Return to the home screen
1. Give a staff member 6 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
1. Give a staff member exactly 10 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
1. Give a staff member 11 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
tests.expected: Only 10 days are carried over and 1 day is shown as lost (11 is blocked)

tests.steps: 1. Give a staff member 15 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
tests.expected: Only 10 days are carried over and 5 days are shown as lost
